sections.title: Knowledge check — Test yourself
sections.body:
Try answering these five questions before checking the answers.

**Batch 4 assessment** · (0/5 answered)

**1. An AI agent receives a request to transfer money. Who should validate the transfer amount and permissions?**

- [ ] The LLM only

- [ ] The backend security layer

- [ ] The system prompt

- [ ] The vector database

**2. An agent has access to tools it does not need. What is this vulnerability?**

- [ ] Prompt leakage

- [ ] Excessive agency

- [ ] Authentication failure

- [ ] Model drift

**3. What does authentication answer?**

- [ ] What can you access?

- [ ] Who are you?

- [ ] Which model should run?

- [ ] What is your token limit?

**4. In a secure RAG system, when should document authorization happen?**

- [ ] After generating the answer

- [ ] Only when the user complains

- [ ] Before unauthorized documents enter the LLM context

- [ ] Only during ingestion

**5. A manager can read reports only from their own department. Which model handles this contextual condition?**

- [ ] RBAC only

- [ ] ABAC

- [ ] API key authentication

- [ ] JWT encoding

Submit answers

sections.title: Practical assignment
sections.body:
**Build a secure AI customer-support agent.**

Your agent should:

1. Authenticate users using JWT.
2. Support employee and admin roles.
3. Allow users to retrieve only their own order information.
4. Allow managers to access their team's records.
5. Provide a refund tool with amount validation.
6. Require human approval for refunds above a configured threshold.
7. Log every sensitive tool execution.

Try implementing this with FastAPI and LangGraph.
